summary: Conservative checked source-candidate links are suitable. Three concrete completeness refinements are required: preserve nominal principal identity sources alongside resolution candidates; traverse all reachable checked operations rather than relying on copied route contracts; generate admission-only actor-constraint change scenarios as well as auth/add/remove scenarios. The recipe below is approved as narrow planning scope with these constraints; no new owner semantic choice is needed. Implementation remains unreviewed.

plan_anchor.heading: Following actor-to-route slice — short plan, independent challenge first:
plan_anchor.concurrency: Main owns concurrent principal docs/gate work. No actor-route implementation inspected or approved; source hashes are observation-epoch pins, not locks.

blocking_refinements.topic: Exact principal identity source is broader and narrower than authority-entity equality
blocking_refinements.finding: The plan names resolution candidates only. Existing lowering also uses explicit principal variant fields typed Entity.identity. Omitting that checked nominal path would mark supported golden User.id/Service.id identity sources unknown. Conversely a resolution authority Entity.field match is only an entity-associated candidate: usable identity projection additionally depends on a source mapping of the entity identity field to the explicit principal target. A same-entity nonidentity projection cannot be labeled a role-identity source merely because its base scalar type matches.
blocking_refinements.required: Emit distinct nominal_identity_field and authority_resolution candidate kinds. Preserve full principal declaration/variant/kind/target and nominal Entity.identity path. For each resolution preserve exact authority entity/field, mapping source/target, active predicate/inactive failure, and identify whether it explicitly maps the referenced entity identity. Keep entity-associated nonidentity candidates with identity_composition unresolved/not_present, not usable identity. Attach exact validator principal selections as candidates without choosing a route validator. Never infer user/service from entity spelling, UUID equality, role namespace, or *_id fallback.
blocking_refinements.acceptance: Golden nominal User.id/Service.id with matching and differently named variant fields; resolution with same entity but nonidentity source; plain Uuid principal field without mapping must not become a nominal link. Keep user/service variants distinct.

blocking_refinements.topic: Reach every checked operation and preserve surface provenance
blocking_refinements.finding: Operation entity effects propagate through calls, but field_reads are collected locally; each callable's own invoke policy lives on that callable. Route contracts clone direct callee contracts and overwrite source with transitive_operation, losing original entity/operation_exception/typed_expression provenance. A link builder using route_policy_contract alone can therefore omit deeper invoke/field constraints or fabricate their owner. Current operation_policy JSON also omits PolicyFieldRead.source.
blocking_refinements.required: Build per-operation surfaces directly from checked PolicyModel, retaining PolicyObligation.source and PolicyFieldRead.source. Resolve policy operation identity to checked semantic node identity; BFS from each HTTP route through semantic CallEdge caller/callee IDs visits every reachable policy-bearing callable. Retain a deterministic shortest witness per route/operation surface. Include route-local/copy-derived surfaces separately with exact observed source and [route] witness; do not relabel an inherited aggregate as a direct enforcement site or infer its originating callee. Distinguish inherited aggregate summaries from original callable surfaces; preserve full graph for alternatives/cycles.
blocking_refinements.acceptance: Route→wrapper→protected invoke and route→wrapper→restricted-field callee; direct inline route effect/read; cycle/alternate path deterministic witness. Exact expected operation/field/source/route assertions, not just nonempty link lists.

blocking_refinements.topic: Admission-only scenarios must include changed actor constraints
blocking_refinements.finding: The plan limits effectless-route admission scenarios to added/removed/auth-changed routes. An application-membership or principal projection change affecting a pure invoke route has neither a terminal effect nor an auth-mode change, so that limit leaves the same actor-route gap open.
blocking_refinements.required: For routes without terminal effects on either compared side, emit admission-only scenarios on addition/removal, auth change OR route actor-link contract change, including nested invoke sources. Compare exact before/after link values or resolved contract digests, not only stable source IDs. For after-only subjects classify absence-of-baseline explicitly; do not call it newly feasible. If terminal-effect presence differs, retain existing effect scenarios; do not create a fake terminal effect. Keep admission identity separate from route/effect IDs.
blocking_refinements.acceptance: ApplicationMembership member/source change and principal projection change affecting an effectless invoke route with unchanged grant strings/auth/call graph; pure public-health auth none↔required; add/remove health route; unchanged baseline yields no change scenario.

mandatory_contract_constraints.rule: Subjects on one exact target/effect surface are alternatives (OR); independent entity/effect/field/nested-call requirements compose conjunctively (POLICY-D13). Preserve groups; do not flatten them into an effective permission set. Access.public requires no principal on that surface but does not override route auth or other constraints. Access.authenticated admits any valid user/service principal, not an inferred User entity or role. Restricted-field reads remain additional narrowing surfaces.

For a qualified role use exact full direct binding.role equality, with matching checked resource scope. Membership uses exact role enum type plus requested variant and application OR matching resource scope; keep member entity/field and role field exact. Application membership remains eligible independently of an entity's resource scope, including mixed-scope policies. Retain protected entity scope_field or identity scope path and binding/membership scope fields, plus symbolic same-principal/member equality, scope-key equality and role-variant equality. Source row existence/currentness and actual equality values remain unproved. For invoke, obligation.entity is callable identity and scope is application, not a made-up entity policy.

Emit all checked source contracts/candidates even when composition cannot be established. Use explicit statuses for identity projection, route strategy/validator selection, runtime principal validity, current row membership and feasibility. [] means no checked candidate in a successfully checked model; missing live authority is not a reason to replace supported rows with blanket null. Do not copy trusted unauthenticated-fixture *_id lowering fallback into an authenticated source guarantee.

mandatory_contract_constraints.topic: Stable identity, exact deltas and no join by display names
mandatory_contract_constraints.rule: Use semantic tuple identities including operation, surface kind, entity, effect/field, provenance, subject and source contract identity. Hash canonical tuples with unambiguous boundaries; source offsets, numeric NodeIds, witness path and mutable contract contents are not durable identity. Join operations/nodes via checked kind/identity and resolved call endpoints, not suffix/name resemblance. Sort/dedup true sets; preserve ordered tokens and witness paths. before/after derive independently and union stable keys; changed source/conditions retain identity where intended, rename removes/adds.

Keep existing effect scenario IDs/shape/meaning and canonicalization intact. An admission row needs an explicit discriminator, admission-specific certainty such as compiler_checked_route_contract, null/no terminal effect, exact before/after route auth and actor contracts, execution not_proved and feasibility not_analyzed. Use a separate admission identity domain (e.g. hash canonical [scenario.admission.v1,route]). Do not label it a terminal compiler_checked_may_call witness or feasible access. Owning docs currently describe every scenario as a may-effect summary; owner must reconcile that description for the additive subtype. No closed external scenario schema or mandatory version violation was found in inspected generic Value exporter; additive v5 facets are acceptable if existing meanings/IDs remain intact. Reinterpretation/removal of existing fields would require separate version-contract assessment.

smallest_approved_implementation_recipe: Build a sorted operation_actor_sources facet from PolicyModel surfaces; each row contains exact source evidence, subject group and full role/member condition candidates. Insert stable individual link facts for normal decisions.

Build an index of checked nominal principal identity fields and resolution/mapping candidates keyed by exact referenced entity identity. Attach contract IDs AND exact content/digests, distinguishing association from identity projection and unresolved route validator selection. Consume separately reviewed principal helper facts without modifying their established semantics.

Walk semantic CallEdge IDs with deterministic ordered BFS for each HTTP route. Attach every reachable operation's surfaces with shortest operation witness; add route-owned surfaces with explicit inherited/local distinction. Do not reuse terminal-effect extraction as the sole reachability index.

Publish sorted route_actor_sources facts that include full referenced candidate contract snapshots/digests so binding, membership, scope and projection changes become affected-route decisions even when subjects/topology are unchanged.

Extend route_actor_constraints_changed comparison to those exact link contracts. Add separate admission-only rows for effectless changed routes, including actor-link changes, while preserving existing route/effect scenarios.

Keep nonreleasable status and source-input/compiler manifest binding; update owner evidence/unknown labels narrowly to acknowledge extracted static links while retaining runtime/effective authority/feasibility uncertainty.

Verify owner implementation with independently expected paired fixtures and rehashed omission rejection against freshly generated subjects. No complete-RM601 or RM603 eligibility claim follows from this slice.
required_owner_acceptance_cases: Policy-runtime Article read/update routes: CompanyRole.owner direct Company.owner_id AND scoped CompanyMembership candidates; editor/viewer do not gain owner direct binding; exact Article.company_id scope relation preserved.

ApplicationRole administrator/operator: User and Service memberships distinct; application conditions remain independent from resource scope. Binding/member field change with unchanged grants/call graph identifies exact affected operations/routes.
Read User.private_email through administrative_details: operation_exception and typed restricted-field source remain distinct exact surfaces; nested caller does not erase them.

Nominal golden identity and authority-resolution identity/nonidentity/absent candidates; Bool active predicate or identity projection change visible in associated route contracts without claiming live access.
Direct inline route, transitive wrapper and nested invoke/field routes; cycle/alternate path witnesses stable; no suffix-matched unrelated operation.
Effectless added/removed/auth-changed AND actor-constraint-changed routes; unchanged/after-only classification and no fabricated effect.

Semantic set reorder does not change semantic link identity/order; ordered expression/witness data retained. Rehashed omission of one supported link, principal candidate or admission row must fail fresh subject equality.
Invalid source remains frontend rejection, not an empty successful actor candidate set; negative expectations independent from exporter output.
